company_info.company_description: "Positive Energy Solutions is a market leader in solar panels and solar batteries, with a strong focus on premium brands and installation. Positive Energy’s reputation is built around a no- pressure consultative approach, delivering the highest quality installations in Perth.The company was the #1 Rated Solar Company in Perth on SolarQuotes in both 2023 and 2024.Why Choose Positive Energy Solutions?At Positive Energy their staff are experts, with most of them being in the industry for 10 years or more. They have a detailed understanding of products and system design, as well as regulations and manufacturers specifications.They will be able to answer any questions you throw at them and give you straightforward and honest advice.Positive Energy will complete all the applications for your solar and battery installation. They also use the leading solar and battery installers in Perth. The company's solar installers are fully licensed electricians and SAA accredited.Once the installation is complete they will set up and proactively monitor your system to ensure it never has any downtime.Premium Solar panels, Solar Batteries, Inverters and mounting systemsPositive Energy Solutions focuses on premium solar panels, solar batteries, inverters and mounting systems.Before stocking new products, the firm completes thorough due diligence on the manufacturers, followed by detailed product training. They only use manufacturers with a strong Australian presence, ensuring good after- sales support, warranty process and the manufacturers intent to remain in the market. They avoid lower quality cheap inverters and batteries as these are often the first thing to fail, and a cheap solar system will often cost you a lot more money in the long term.Regardless of how attractive a low price may seem, it is quality that lasts the test of time.Positive Energy have installed solar and battery systems throughout Perth WA, for residences and businessesThey pride themselves on their high quality of work, and won’t rest until you are completely happy with the final product on your roof. With Positive Energy Solutions, you can rest easy knowing that you are dealing with a solar and battery provider who is genuinely here to help you.In Home AssessmentsPositive Energy Solutions are happy to come out to your home or business and explain how a solar and battery system can help to reduce your electricity bills for many years to come. What you can expect to gain from an obligation free in-home assessment:A no pressure consultation explaining how a solar and batteries workAn assessment of your roof in terms of its suitability for solar panelsAdvice on the best sized solar and battery system to suit your needsExpected investment returns and payback periods.Information on selecting the right panels and battery to suit your needs.Alternatively, the same level of detail can be completed over the phone and email if preferred."

reviews.review_description: Great installers, battery running great.Louis provided great service a+

In support of the Solar Quotes concept I am writing to relay positive feedback for Positive Energy Solutions. Following the initial solar install we took some time to consider battery options and landed on a 15 kW iStore battery for our 6.5 kW invertor. The battery install was quick, efficient and very informative regarding the system operation. While we have not yet seen our first bill I can see from the daily diagnostics that there will be significant savings.Bottom line I highly recommend Positive Energy Solutions

We are very happy with our new 19.8 kW solar PV system and 25 kWh battery system.  It replaces our old 6kW system that Positive Energy Solutions removed as part of the package.  The entire process from initial contact / signup to installation and after service has been a positive experience.Adon our sales rep was very knowledgable, non-pushy, and a pleasure to deal with.  He answered my questions and stated the facts when it came to different brands and setup combinations. A lot of that information was verified and confirmed by cross referencing with the vast amount of information on the Solarquotes website.Installation was relatively painless with the installers being polite, courteous, and cleaning up after themselves.  Once the installation was completed, I was given a rundown on how the system works and how to use the iSolarCloud app..Everything to do with battery rebates and VPP's was handled by Positive Energy Solutions.  I was sent the relative information to complete and return, and it was all set up for me.  The whole process was very easy and simple.I would definitely recommend Positive Energy Solutions to anyone considering purchasing a new system or upgrading their older system.

To start with, the sales staff were very friendly and helpful - even coming to site to answer a few queries I had when most suppliers were under the pump with the new rebates kicking in and couldn't come. The final system quoted was adapted to fit our budget.The install itself was done on time, with friendly and professional staff, particularly discussing the best location for the battery and inverter. The handover at end of day was very simple and straightforward.And now the system is running for 3 weeks and we have not drawn any energy from the gird after first day (we have had good conditions for the time it has been in place).Its early days yet, but the initial experience of converting to using solar and battery has been very good!

Great service and kept me fully informed along the way. Very happy to recommend Positive Energy Solutions. Definitely a 5 stars!Sales were patient with all my questions and quote clear with several options. Installation went very smoothly. Got a great rundown of how the inverter and batteries worked and all the the safety instructions. Installer was prompt, tidied up and even installed a bollard. Very happy. It looks great.So glad I went with the recommendation of Positive Energy Solutions, to add batteries to my existing solar system.

We ordered a BYD HVM 22.1 kWh battery with Fronius 3 phase backup controller to complement our existing solar panels and Fronius inverter. The team at Positive Energy Solutions made it a smooth process throughout. There was regular communication with prompt responses to my queries. The battery was neatly installed last week and is performing as expected. All associated administration (e.g. application for rebates and connection to grid) were handled by them.We would gladly recommend Positive Energy Solutions to others.

Starting from the quote stage it was simple, not pushy and informative. Other quotes I had people phoning me up and asking how much I had been quoted and who I went with. I refused to answer. Simply give your best quote at the time and cut the bull. This is what Positive Energy Solutions did.Was very impressed with the help they gave to fill in tbe forms and answer my questions. The installation date was very prompt. I was waiting for the excuses and the delays but none came. Very impressed. Even after sales was impressive. Thank you so much.
We had a really good experience with the installer that was efficient and left our place tidy

Louis and the team at Positive Energy were quick to respond to my email inquiry, calling me back the next business day whilst inundated with other potential clients also looking to capitalise on the WA and Federal home battery rebates.As I was only looking to upgrade my current system, from a single 5kwh battery to a 15kwh battery setup, Louis was able to find time between bigger installation projects to have his lead battery installer, Ryan, to come around and upgrade my system.Ryan and his apprentice were super friendly, showed up a good 5 minutes before their scheduled arrival time and did an amazing job. The team were very tidy, cleaning up all rubbish and vacuuming everywhere around their workspace.They not only installed the extra battery modules and did all the back end work to have the plant activated, they went through and double checked my battery failover system (originally installed by a different provider) and found that not only were some of the crucial wires not terminated properly there were incorrect connections made - so they fixed the terminations and rewired the circuit as necessary, then tested it repeatedly to ensure that it was properly working.The accounts team were very friendly and not pushy in trying to get their money immediately but were first asking if I was happy with the quality of the service, making the interaction very pleasant for me as a consumer.All round, a very pleasant experience and one I have been recommending to everyone in WA who has talked to me about wanting to get or upgrade their solar system.I will return to Positive Energy Solutions should I need to do any further modifications to my system in the future, or if I move house and look to add solar energy to it.

Our Solar and Battery install with Positive Energy was trouble free and seamless.All the installers we encountered were first rate. They were professional, respectful and easy to communicate with. They were also very well supported by there back office planning and scheduling team. Specifically I'd would like to acknowledge the efforts of Maria. I can only imagine how challenging the last few months have been. Maria was always highly organised and communicated very clearly and effectively with us.All up it's been a very satisfying experience and we would highly recommend Positive Energy to our friends and colleagues.

Sales staff were very responsive (emails and calls) and a representative came to the house to check on the environment and provide answers to questions - noting that many suppliers were flooded with sales and inquiries at the time.

I chose Positive Energy Solutions because I felt more comfortable with the products they offer and stand by. The sales approach wasn't a pressure tactic either. Thank you PES!

Positive Energy Solutions have done a great installation. The system has been running for over a year now and we are happy with the result. We definitely recommend Positive Energy Solutions for your solar system installation.

Everything went smoothly and was beyond my expectations. I am so happy with Positive energy solutions. Recommend them highly.

Positive Energy was referred to me by a trusted friend and they were great from initial communication,  to install,  to after sales support. I highly recommend Positive Energy a great group of people to deal with

Clear advice with great communication and a flawless install. The system is performing brilliantly and the team were all outstanding. Thanks Louis, Pam.
I haven’t had the best experience with tradies in the past but this is a highly professional team from start to finish.Can highly recommend.

After the 3rd of 12 original panels failed,  a long list of empty promises by Perth Solar Warehouse and even the inability to return calls when I suggested I was considering replacing the system with one including a battery I gave up on attempting to deal with them and started the adventure to install a new and improved system.Sadly when you have a 2 story townhouse with a smaller more complicated roof plan many installers seem happy to write down a very generic set of specs with a big price tag they know won’t fit and hope you go away. So after a few false starts I had the pleasure of meeting Louis from Positive Energy.Having not long added an EV to the garage and wanting to add a battery made for rather a challenge to design a system that would produce enough power but also fit and make use of the roof space that faces SE/SW that would usually be ignored by most installers. At our first meeting Louis had 3 different system designs with alternative batteries for each design and a few panel options at a significant discount. It was refreshing to see someone that knew all the products he was offering inside out and wanted to sell the right option for me rather than what was most profitable like many others would.At the time Tesla Powerwall 3 was just going through the approvals process and we decided to go that way as the combined inverter battery makes for a neat install and I was very much sold on the LFP chemistry for any battery that was going to live in my garage over NMC.Cut to a few weeks later and Hiroshi the electrician/installer came round with his tape measure and had to break the news that 5 of the panels were just not going to fit which would result in a drop in output of nearly 20% from the original design. Thankfully Louis had the patience of a saint and continued to come up with alternatives including some larger commercial panels but nothing was quite right. We were now well inside a month from install date and still struggling to find a panel with a high enough output, small enough dimensions to work and available before the install date. Our saviour came in the form of Aiko 475w panels available with a whole week to spare. Cutting it fine to say the least.Our final system Tesla Powerwall 3, 23 Aiko panels for 10.9kw ( 7 of which face SE/SW ) a heap of optimisers and a system that is exceeding expectations by huge margins. Synergy in their wisdom hobble ALL inverters on single phase to 5kw but as long as the battery is not full it will charge above this limit. To keep it simple I can draw the full 5kw for the house and the battery will pull up to 5kw above this. Creating this situation has seen stable solar production peaks of 9.7kw for nearly an hour on the days I actually managed to not fill the battery before 11am. Once the battery is full the system winds down to about 5.2kw for the rest of the day. Biggest days total production 60kw and consistently over 50kw even when the battery is full  well before midday.As for those panels pointing the “wrong way” they are helping me to see 1kw less than 40min after sunrise and not dropping below 1kw until just over an hour before sunset which really helps the battery through the night when I leave both aircon’s going all night.Can’t thank Louis and Hiroshi enough. System is brilliant, the install is incredibly neat and tidy, and their customer service and professionalism fantastic. In an industry full of shonky operators Positive Energy really are a gem and I hope going to the effort of writing this encourages a few readers to find out for themselves.Matt

reviews.review_description: Louis and the installation team did a great job supplying and installing our solar system. Would recommend them without question to anyone looking for solar.Louis went above and beyond following up multiple installation quotes over several months trying to optimize our solution in the current trades restricted market.We have a complicated Subiaco extension, with limited roof space and steep pitch. These were viewed as a challenge not obstacles and the team did a great job arriving early in the morning on the day of install and safely installing the 6.6kW system in one day.
Dale and the team at Positive Energy were fantastic to deal with from day 1. Quote was competitive and install was top quality.
Great team!  Excellent service. Terrific quality of products and installation.   Listens to the customer.   Very helpful.

The team at Positive Energy were amazing through the entire process. Instead of just telling you what you need, they explained what everything was for as well as alternates that are available. They were happy to answer all questions and explained them in a simplified way that anyone can understand. You made our transition to solar super easy, thank you very much!

In home consultation was wonderful, Louis went through the whole system and returns we could expect. He sold us the original 6.6kw system, we installed 5 years ago so was great to know we could expand it to serve our needs.Installation team was prompt, polite and super efficient. One of the neatest installs I have seen from looking online. Could not recommend Louis, Danny Hiroshi & the team!

Rep came out to quote and didn’t simply send an email quote. Answers all questions fully and gave options.Installers arrived on time and finished on time, cleaned up the site before leaving. Explained the system and checked all working before leaving.

Positive Energy worked hard to ensure our solar panel + battery system was tailored to our home and our expected energy use. They did an excellent job.From planning the job, to signing up the contract, to completing the installation, their team was professional and worked hard.We installed 16.4kw of panels and a 25.6kwh battery just before the height of summer. We are now running our pool filter for 8 hours, pool heater for 3-4 hours and aircon for 3+ hours per day, plus all the usual daily appliances, and on average 95% of our daily electricity now comes from the sun. An outstanding result! Hopefully we get a similar result in winter when the sun is lower in the sky.Just make sure your expectations are realistic and buy the right sized system to match your electricity needs. Positive Energy's advice was invaluable in this regard.

I requested a premium solar and battery system and was provided great, easy to understand advice. Installation of the panels and the battery was equally professional. I needed additional roof tiles and Kyle and the guys went well beyond their duty to assist in obtaining them. Very tidy and punctual and very hard working. Had a minor issue at the very end which was promptly fixed and dealt with. Well done guys…..would highly recommend.

We have an unusual roof layout so one of my requirements was to actually come to the house to see it. They came out and actually brought one of their installers with them. Very good start.Price was competitive with others that were quoted.Multiple options provided. Bit of back and forth about what will work and so forth but overall the process was simple, we had to do very little.
Nice sales and install staff. Answered all my dumb questions

Positive Energy did a fabulous job of installing my solar system and went out of their way to assist me on a warranty claim on my existing system. Louis and his teams service was fantastic and i can recommend them highly.

Positive Energy Solutions were the logical choice for us when we decided to get solar on our new property. Positive Energy Solutions provided me with options and information to make an informed choice for a solar installation with a battery.  The installation was professional and efficient.  They turned up on the day at the allocated time and completed the work with attention to detail, being neat and tidy as well thoroughly cleaning up before leaving. Met and exceeded  expectations.  Highly recommended.

When we decided to get solar panels we rang 5 different companies for quotes. The only company that offered to come over to inspect the site, discuss the options and quote in person was Positive Energy Solutions.Dale and Louis booked a time to come over and talk us through everything and we also included our neighbours who were also interested in a quote for their place.One company who quoted cheaper than Positive Energy was appealing until we did a little research and discovered they were based in Queensland, were quoting for solar panels that had been around for over 4 years and didn’t take into account the height of our 2 storey, steep pitched buildings.Our power bills have been massively reduced and even after the hottest summer in Perth the biggest electricity bill we have paid is around $200 for a 2-3 person household.We are very happy to recommend Positive Energy Solutions to anyone wanting to deal with a Perth based, family owned, customer service ethos business.

Last year we did a major renovation and decided to add a small solar system to the project. Out of all the trades we dealt with Positive Energy was one of the best to deal with. We are very happy with our system and the service we received.
The guys that installed were very tidy and left no no mess at all.

From meeting the Positive energy team at the beginning of the journey for the quote on our system, right through to the installation of system and then finally to the commissioning of the system, Positive energy were nothing but impressive.
